rubric.role_summary: Customer-facing security Solutions Engineer leading technical discovery, demos, and evaluations for prospects while improving sales-engineering workflows through automation and reusable tools.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Customer-facing security Solutions Engineer leading technical discovery, demos, and evaluations for prospects while improving sales-engineering workflows through automation and reusable tools.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Experience in a customer-facing security role, such as Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Security Consultant.
- Hands-on experience with cybersecurity products and real environments.
- Discovery, demo, and evaluation skills.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience using AI-assisted software development tools.
- Experience supporting SMB or MSP buyers.
- Experience with email security, post-breach response, or adjacent security categories.
- Experience creating reusable demo environments, evaluation tooling, or internal workflow automation.
- Experience working in an early-stage or fast-moving startup environment.
- Experience using APIs, scripts, spreadsheets, no-code tools, or AI-assisted workflows to remove manual work.
- A track record of building something useful for teammates, customers, or internal operators.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
